verdict.rationale: Format-pair compatibility documentation is a fair question for a media converter, so the axis applies. The pack shows only generic conversion examples (e.g. mp4→avi) and release notes about individual formats such as IAMF read/write and Matroska/MP4 cropping metadata. Nothing shows a documented input-to-output format matrix or supported-formats reference a user could check before trying a pair.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it
